senses.gloss:
The word अपि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it implies, the sense of word 'understood' ('somewhat') or 'possibility' (e.g. 'even' in the sense of such a great person), or permission to do as one likes, ('if you like'), or censure ('even' in the sense of what is disgraceful); or collection ('and').

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय
